title: Ten unknowns for Hilbert's tenth problem over the integers
summary: Hilbert's Tenth Problem over the integers was solved negatively by Y. Matiyasevich in 1970. In this paper, we prove that there is no algorithm to determine for any polynomial equation $P(z_1,\ldots,z_{10})=0$ (with integer coefficients and ten unknowns) whether it has integer solutions. This improves the previous 11 unknowns theorem.
